addClaims.text: Unlisted (non-Marketplace) commercially distributed apps get 1 request per minute and at most 15 objects per request on the affected history methods.
addClaims.quote: The new rate limits will be updated to allow 1 request per minute and will return a maximum of 15 objects per request.

addClaims.text: Distributed apps must support SSL (HTTPS) for OAuth redirect URLs and request URLs.
addClaims.quote: Your app must support SSL for all of the following URLs: - OAuth redirect URLs

verdict.summary: Unlisted distribution is self-serve in minutes, but unlisted apps created after May 29, 2025 get conversations.history throttled to 1 request/minute; lifting that needs Slack Marketplace approval (10+ active workspaces, up to 10 weeks of review).

replaceScopes.purpose: Read public channel messages (via conversations.history / conversations.replies)
replaceScopes.alternative: Request Marketplace approval if your agent reads history at volume: unlisted apps are limited to 1 request/minute on these methods
Use granular bot scopes; Marketplace review rejects legacy/restricted scopes

addRequirements.label: Marketplace approval to avoid the 1 request/minute history limit
addRequirements.when: Only if your agent reads channel history at volume and the app is distributed outside your own workspace

addUncertainties: Exact scope names for history access depend on conversation type (channels:, groups:, im:, mpim:history); the guide shows channels:history as the common case.
